tree_view.description: Start in tree view mode (F5 toggle). Corresponds to -t or F5.

highlight_changes.description: Highlight new and old processes (H key). Corresponds to --highlight-changes.

highlight_base_name.description: Highlight the base name of the executable. Corresponds to Display Options > Highlight base name.

highlight_megabytes.description: Highlight deleted executables. Corresponds to Display Options > Highlight deleted executables.

color_scheme.description: Color scheme to use (e.g., default, blackbox, blackbox-light, linux). Corresponds to Setup > Colors > Color Scheme.

delay.description: Delay between updates in tenths of a second (1-100). Corresponds to -d.

kill_using_niceness.description: Kill process using niceness (F9 > Kill > Yes/No prompt). Corresponds to Setup > Display Options > Kill process using niceness.

detect_cpu_frequency.description: Detect CPU frequency automatically. Corresponds to Setup > Display Options > Detect CPU frequency.

hide_kernel_threads.description: Hide kernel threads (K key). Corresponds to -K or K key.

hide_userland_threads.description: Hide userland threads (-H key). Corresponds to -H.

highlight_column_headers.description: Highlight column headers. Corresponds to Setup > Display Options > Highlight column headers.

show_program_path.description: Show full paths to running programs (-p key). Corresponds to -p.

show_thread_name.description: Show thread names. Corresponds to Setup > Columns > Thread name.

show_program_args.description: Show program arguments. Corresponds to Setup > Columns > Command line.

show_merged_command.description: Merge exe, comm, and cmdline in Command column (m key). Corresponds to m.

hide_program_by_mask.description: Hide processes by mask. Corresponds to Setup > Display Options > Hide process by mask.

user_filter.description: Show only processes of a given user (-u). Empty means no filter.

filter_by_capabilities.description: Filter by capabilities. Corresponds to Setup > Display Options > Filter by capabilities.

preferred_cgroup_mode.description: Preferred cgroup display mode (0: disabled, 1: cgroup name, 2: cgroup path).

sort_key.description: Column to sort by (e.g., PID, USER, PERCENT_CPU, PERCENT_MEM, TIME, COMMAND). Use 'help' in htop to list valid keys.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction (0: increasing, 1: decreasing). Corresponds to I key toggle.

fields.description: List of column names to display in the process list. Valid keys include PID, USER, PRI, NI, VIRT, RES, STATE, PERCENT_CPU, PERCENT_MEM, TIME, COMMAND, etc.

cpu_count.description: Number of CPUs to display in meters (1: total, >1: individual). Corresponds to Setup > Meters > CPU.

cpu_display.description: How to display CPU usage in meters (Total, per-core, or specific core index).

cpu_frequency.description: CPU frequency override in MHz (0: auto-detect). Corresponds to Setup > Display Options > CPU frequency.

memory_units.description: Memory units for display (0: KiB, 1: MiB, 2: GiB). Corresponds to Setup > Display Options > Memory units.

io_rate_units.description: I/O rate units (0: KiB, 1: MiB, 2: GiB). Corresponds to Setup > Display Options > I/O rate units.

clock_format.description: Clock format string. Corresponds to Setup > Display Options > Clock format.

tabs.description: List of tab names to display. Default screen layout.
